fact: Car 5 was released into the path of Car 30.
offence: Breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. Car 5 was released into the path of Car 30. Car 30 had to brake and take avoiding action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 5 Unsafe Release
to: The Team Manager, Kick Sauber F1 Team
